params.body:
The public proposal page (`/voorstel/{token}`, PR 437/442) did not look like Stocklist: Shane saw a serif system font on cream with a navy-ish accent.

**Root cause of the serif.** `_layout.blade.php` printed the dealer's `website_font` through `{{ }}` inside `<style>`. Blade escaped the quotes to `"`, which a `<style>` block does not decode, so `font-family: var(--pp-font)` substituted an invalid value and the browser fell back to its default font (Times). Any dealer with a Website font set got a serif page.

**What changed**
- The page loads the app's self-hosted Inter (`@font-face` for `/fonts/InterVariable.woff2`, as in `resources/css/tailwind.css`) and uses the same stack as `layouts/guest` and `layouts/app`; the dealer's Google font, when set, comes first with Inter as fallback.
- The `--brand-*` tokens of `refresh.css` (ink, gray, faint, line, field, blue, green, red, radius) are copied into the page's inline style; text colours follow the house rule (labels faint or gray, values and headings ink).
- White cards on the app's `#eaeef4` ground (`.page-wrapper`) instead of cream; card look as `.ui-card` (radius 14, soft line, light shadow).
- Buttons like `ui-button` / `ui-button--primary`: radius 8, weight 600, primary in the accent (Stocklist blue `#0a8fd4` by default), secondary white with the brand line and gray text. 44px tall for the customer's thumb.
- Amounts and facts in tabular figures.
- Default accent is now `ProposalPage::DEFAULT_ACCENT` (`#0a8fd4`, `--brand-blue`) instead of the website default `#249DE0`. The dealer's `website_headcolor` / `website_font` still override, as before.
- The font name is reduced to letters, digits and spaces (`ProposalPage::fontName()`) and then printed with `{!! !!}`, so it can neither be double-escaped nor break out of the declaration.
- The expired page shares the layout and follows. The proposal mail already uses the app's markdown mail layout; untouched.

**Test.** `ProposalPublicPageTest::test_the_page_wears_the_stocklist_house_style_unless_the_dealer_set_a_website_look` (`@rule S4-2.19`): the font face, the tokens, the ground, tabular figures, no Google font without a dealer font, no `#249DE0`; with dealer settings the accent and the Google font take over, no `"` in the page, a hostile font name is defused; the expired page carries the same style.

Filter `Proposal|CompiledViews|StylesheetSyntax|RulesCoverage`: OK (35 tests, 902 assertions).

Screenshots (1440 and 390, before and after, page and expired page) in `.playwright-mcp/proposal-style/` of the worktree.
params.title: The proposal page wears the Stocklist house style
